headline: Frontline Flare‑Ups Spike Across Western Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the western arc has grown noticeably hotter. Fishermans Row added three more ownership changes, reaching thirty‑six flips in the past day, while Weathered Expanse surged to twenty‑six, up eight from the previous count. Lykos Isle remains steady at twenty‑one, and Stlican Shelf holds at twelve. New contested zones have appeared: Deadlands recorded five flips, Farranac Coast eight, and Tempest Island nine, all with recent timestamps. Godcrofts climbed to eight flips from six. Casualty streams tell a mixed story – Stonecradle has exploded to over four hundred colonial and three hundred warden casualties per hour, both accelerating sharply; Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor and Marban Hollow are still heavy but cooling; Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Deadlands and Kings Cage show easing loss rates. Enlistment rates are rising in Godcrofts, Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, hinting at fresh reinforcements. The deep Warden interior (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Callahans Passage, etc.) and the Colonial‑held south (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Heartlands) remain quiet with no base turnovers. No strategic bases have changed hands on the static fronts.
